display_title: The Symbiotic Relationship Between a PD and His Writer
description:
Webtoon artist Seol U-Young decided to try his hand at BL after seeing positive reactions on social media. To gather proper research material, U-Young heads to a gay bar, where he runs into Jun-Hyuk. Though he genuinely wanted to help Jun-Hyuk, who was asking for assistance in a tough spot, Jun-Hyuk mercilessly tramples on U-Young's kind intentions.

 *'How could I have been charmed by such trash!'*

Feeling pathetic, U-Young ends up having the worst day ever. Then one day, U-Young receives notice that his assigned PD is changing. A few days later, at the meeting that follows, he finds himself face to face again with Jun-Hyuk, that piece of trash not even fit for recycling.

 *“PD-nim?! I'm having a hard time...”

“I'm still lacking. We need mutual satisfaction for a symbiotic relationship. Right, Writer?”*

But how did we end up in this kind of relationship?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
